hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about healthy eating, nutrition, and our website.

items.question: What is Healthy Awareness?
items.answer: Healthy Awareness is a trusted platform that provides science-backed information about foods, nutrition, healthy living tips, recipes, and more. Our goal is to help you make informed food choices for a healthier life.

items.question: How do I find the nutritional information of a food?
items.answer: You can use our search bar at the top or browse through the Healthy Foods section by category. Each food page displays detailed macro/micronutrient breakdown, health score, and intake guidelines.

items.question: Can your food recommendations help with health conditions?
items.answer: Our content is research-backed and highlights foods that support immunity, heart health, digestion, and diabetes management. However, we advise consulting a medical professional for clinical treatment.

items.question: Are the recipes on this site healthy and diet-friendly?
items.answer: Yes! All recipes on Healthy Awareness are created with natural, nutrient-rich ingredients, minimal refined sugars, and clear calorie & nutrient counts.

items.question: How often are new tips and articles published?
items.answer: We publish fresh health guides, seasonal dietary tips, and research summaries weekly. Subscribe to our newsletter to stay updated!

items.question: Why should I eat seasonal foods?
items.answer: Eating fruits and vegetables in season ensures maximum nutrient density, better natural flavor, lower pesticide load, and environmentally sustainable eating.

items.question: How does the food comparison feature work?
items.answer: Our comparison tool lets you select any two food items side-by-side to compare calories, protein, fiber, vitamins, glycaemic index, and health scores instantly.

items.question: Do I need to create an account to use the website?
items.answer: No account is required! You can access all food guides, nutrition facts, comparisons, and recipes freely. Creating an account lets you save favorite foods.

items.question: Is my personal information safe with you?
items.answer: Yes, we prioritize user privacy. We do not sell your personal data. Read our Privacy Policy for full details on encryption and security measures.

items.question: How can I contact Healthy Awareness?
items.answer: You can reach out to our team anytime through our Contact Us page or email us directly at hello@healthyawareness.com.
